manifest.name: FastAPI
manifest.workers: BENCH_WORKERS Uvicorn worker processes (2), one event loop each
manifest.database_layer: SQLModel 0.0.50 on SQLAlchemy 2.1 with psycopg 3 (sync sessions, as in the FastAPI SQL tutorial), DB_POOL_SIZE / BENCH_WORKERS connections per process

phase2.validation: Path and query parameter types, a Query() parameter model, a Pydantic body model (StrictInt) and a Form() model: 422

csrf.mechanism: asgi-csrf 0.11 (signed double-submit csrftoken cookie and form field; 403), on the mounted browser sub-application

session.mechanism: Starlette SessionMiddleware (itsdangerous-signed cookie holding the user id), on the mounted browser sub-application; pwdlib Argon2 on users.password_argon2id

manifest.structure_note: Python 3.14.10, as in FastAPI's container guide (Django runs 3.15.2)
